sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Crystal White CZ Gold-Plated Anti-Tarnish Vine Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Timeless and sophisticated — our Crystal Diamond Vine Anti-Tarnish Necklace features sparkling clear white marquise CZ stones arranged in an elegant V-shaped vine design on a gold-plated chain. Clean, minimalist, and brilliantly radiant — this necklace goes with everything and elevates any look instantly.
- 💛 Gold-plated with anti-tarnish coating
- 💎 Sparkling clear white marquise CZ stones
- 🌿 Minimalist V-shaped vine design — day to night versatility
- 🔗 Delicate gold chain with secure clasp
- 🎁 Perfect everyday wear, bridal or gifting piece
Pairs beautifully with: Any colour — truly an everyday essential and bridal/mehendi staple.*
